turns.doctor_question: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
I'm here because I'm having a really hard time at work lately. I do bookkeeping, and... well, I just can't stop going back over the same spreadsheets and calculations again and again. 

It's gotten so bad that I'm staying at the office for hours after everyone else leaves. Even when I know I've already checked the numbers, I just get this overwhelming feeling that if I don't do it one more time, something bad will happen and it'll be completely my fault. It's just getting to be too much.
